newsitem.title: GREECE: ECU/DRACHMA PIERCES 312, BONDS, DEPOS, FORWARDS HOLD.
newsitem.headline: ECU/DRACHMA PIERCES 312, BONDS, DEPOS, FORWARDS HOLD.

text.p: The ecu extended its winning streak against the drachma in early dealings recording new all-time highs above 312, depos were steady but for a minor drop in longer tenors, forwards were stable and bonds were holding, traders said.

"The drachma continues to exhibit considerable weakness against the ecu," a forex dealer at a foreign bank said. "Ecu/drachma is currently trading around 312.30/40 and looks set to test new highs unless there is some kind of central bank intervention."
Bank of Greece checked mark/drachma a couple of times so far but it was not viewed as a signal for intervention, dealer said.
"The central bank checks $/drachma if it is serious about intevening," said a forex dealer.

Dealers said the weakness of the drachma could be partly explained by the expiration of two $-linked government loans amounting to $200 million but added that market sentiment had turned against the drachma.

"A number of players have opened speculative long ecu, short drachma positions convinced that ecu/drachma will keep on trending upward and the central bank will stay on the sidelines," said a senior trader at a private bank.
The state will end up paying more in drachmas for the $-linked loans maturing today if the central bank does not intervene to stem the rise of the ecu, the trader said.
Other dealers said the ecu/drachma play was becoming more volatile and more interesting and ecu/drachma could reach the 313 level soon.
Forex forwards were steady and interbank depos were holding Wednesday afternoon levels but for a minor drop in long tenors, dealers said.
Bonds were resting after a hectic Wednesday that had prices gain as much as 100 basis points, bond dealers said.
The finance ministry cut three-, six- and 12-month T-bill rates by 60 basis points to 8.6 percent, 8.9 and 9.7 percent respectively on Wednesday sparking the bond rally.
The mark was quoted at 160.00/10 from Friday's 159.480 fix, the dollar at 271.16/26 drachmas from 272.210 and the ecu at 312.17/27 from 311.200 drachmas.
